yaml_no_longer_supported.title: Family Calendar Sync no longer supports YAML configuration
yaml_no_longer_supported.description:
Family Calendar Sync is now configured entirely through the UI.

Go to **Settings -> Devices & Services -> Add Integration -> Family Calendar Sync** to recreate your sync(s), then remove the `family_calendar_sync:` section from `configuration.yaml`.

sync.name: Sync now
sync.description: Triggers an immediate sync for one Family Calendar Sync entry, or all of them if none is specified.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: The config entry ID to sync. Leave empty to sync all configured entries.
